summary: Iteration 3 targeted retest of two iteration-2 bug fixes. All 8 tests PASS (12.7s). New test module /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_fixes.py covers: (1) Fix #1 status-reset — created a fresh server (loader_id=9 Modrinth, ref=adrenaserver, unique name StatusFix3_{ts}), triggered POST /servers/{id}/modpack/install, waited for completion, verified DB: status='offline' AND modpack_status='installed'. UI verified: [data-testid=server-status] pill contains 'OFFLINE' and [data-testid=modpack-status] contains 'INSTALLED'. Real Modrinth download (~11 jars, ~10-12s). (2) Fix #2 ZIP traversal — imported /app/panel/daemon/pack_resolver.py directly, built a fake .mrpack in-memory with a benign member 'overrides/config/ok.txt' and a malicious member 'overrides/../../etc/foo.txt', called pack_resolver._extract_overrides(zf, tmp_wd, 'overrides', log). Confirmed: return count == 1, benign file was extracted at tmp_wd/config/ok.txt, /etc/foo.txt NOT written, log callback received a '[modpack] ! skipped' warning line. (3) Failure-path — created server with ref='adrenaserver', patched DB to 'definitely-not-a-real-pack-slug-xyz', called install: verified status='crashed', modpack_status='failed', server_logs contains a '[modpack] ✗ FAILED' line. (4) Regression sanity — /json/modpack/preview OK for both Modrinth (fabulously-optimized) and CurseForge (all-the-mods-9); /dashboard, /servers/1 (console text present); existing server id 14 still shows modpack_status='installed'.
critical_code_review_comments: install_modpack_if_needed correctly snapshots prior_status BEFORE calling set_status(sid,'installing'); on success it restores to prior_status (falling back to 'offline' if prior was itself 'installing'/'starting'). On failure it sets 'crashed'. Clean fix.

_extract_overrides now performs both a string-level check (rejects '..' components and absolute paths) AND a resolved-path containment check (target.resolve().relative_to(work_root)). Defense in depth — good.

Minor: the resolved-path check uses target.resolve() which follows symlinks. If a prior benign override created a symlink pointing outside work_dir, a later member could still write outside via the symlink. Consider using os.path.realpath with a strict prefix check, or refuse to overwrite existing symlinks. Not exploitable in current flow because overrides are extracted only once per fresh work_dir.
The success branch still sets modpack_status='installed' via a raw UPDATE followed by set_status() — two round-trips. Could be one UPDATE. Cosmetic.
